Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded the task based on an unverified assumption that the 1967 Pan American Games used a 440-yard track and then incorrectly rounded 10,000 m ÷ 402.336 m ≈ 24.855 laps down to “24 laps.” This both misapplies domain knowledge (major international meets typically use 400 m tracks, yielding 25 laps) and, even under the 440-yard assumption, misstates the lap count (it would not be exactly 24 laps; starts are adjusted to cover the full 10,000 m). The Planner failed to corroborate the track specification and finalized an incorrect answer.
